name: gbPROCESS
description: An R Shiny interface for Hayes’ PROCESS for R, supporting mediation, moderation, and conditional process analyses, with regression diagnostics and visualizations.

name: gbEFA
description: An R Shiny application for exploratory factor analysis and related diagnostics, including factor retention and correlation-matrix options.

name: BioKubios
description: A tool for reading and transferring Biopac ACQ files to a Kubios samples file for batch processing.

name: gbStudyArcade
description: A browser-based learning game for matching terms to definitions, with multiple game modes and support for custom term sets.

name: MIST_gb
description: Browser-based training and mental arithmetic tasks modeled on the Montreal Imaging Stress Task, with adjustable time limits and CSV export of task results.

name: KubiosNoise
description: A Python application for processing Kubios HRV CSV exports and summarizing the duration and percentage of each segment retained after noise exclusion.
